Protocol called W-line is used for [[immobiliser]] communication between [[Body Control Module]] and [[5WY ECM Identification|ECU]] in [[SMARTRA]]-equipped vehicles. 

== Overview ==
Typically, you would now see somewhere around 200 pages of big words and lengthy paragraphs that would probably only increase your confusion and not generate any new knowledge.

However, this is not a ISO specification and I'm not trying to sell you a $1500 device either so I'll just make it simple; '''W-Line is K-Line'''. At least on the physical side. The data layer is documented in [[SMARTRA Protocol]] and physical layer documentation is in [[K-Line|the K-Line article]] already, so there is no point duplicating that. 

I'll only share a tip: [[wikipedia:Local_Interconnect_Network|LIN bus]] also uses the same physical layer. I had a "UART to LIN module" from asian marketplace laying around and used it for my W-line escapades (combined with ''the'' EEPROM programmer, CH134a, running in TTL<>USB mode. I recommend getting the ch134a, it's basically free.)
